entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Support' or 'Sales' to continue.
Support! Get me a person now!
Connecting you to the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Finally! I've been on hold forever. I need to return this helmet. It's ridiculous.

I'm sorry to hear you're not satisfied with your purchase. I can definitely look into the return options for you. To start, may I have your order number or the email address associated with your VeloFit account?
Just look up my name, this is taking too long! It's a simple return. I want my money back.
I understand your frustration. To protect your privacy, I do need to verify your account with an order number or email. Once I have that, I can help you much faster.
Ugh, fine! The email is angrycustomer@example.com. Now hurry up.

Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see your recent order for the Aero-Dynamic Helmet. To make sure I understand correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault with the helmet or a preference?

It's the wrong color! Completely wrong! I ordered obsidian black and I got this faded gray. How am I supposed to feel confident about my safety on the road when you can't even get the color right? The box is still unopened, I haven't even touched the thing.
I see. Thank you for clarifying that for me. I'm pulling up the return policy for your item now.
There's nothing to look up! Just send me a label! If I don't get a refund, I'm posting a review about this on every website I can find. I want to speak to a manager.

That won't be necessary. I've confirmed everything on my end. I can see the helmet was delivered 38 days ago, which is well within our 90-day return policy for standard items. I can absolutely process this return for a full refund for you.
Oh. So you can do it then?

Yes, of course. I've just initiated the return process. A pre-paid shipping label has been sent to the email we discussed. Just print it out, attach it to the package, and drop it off at any post office.
Okay. Well, that's what should have happened in the first place. Make sure that email comes through.
It's already been sent. Once we receive the item back at our warehouse, your refund will be processed within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No. That's it.
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good day.
